    .btn-exit {
        background: #ff3333 !important; color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,51,51,0.4);
    }
    .btn-exit:hover { background: #ff5555 !important; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,51,51,0.6); }

    /* ====== 任务流结构化卡片 ====== */
    .quest-card { background: rgba(0,5,10,0.6); border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.15); padding:12px; margin-bottom:12px; }
    .quest-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px; }
    .quest-title { font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:bold; color:#fff; text-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(0,229,255,0.3); flex:1; }
    .quest-status {
        font-size:0.6rem; font-weight:bold; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:2px; letter-spacing:0.5px;
        text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .quest-status.active { background:rgba(0,229,255,0.15); color:#00e5ff; border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.4); }
    .quest-status.claimable { background:rgba(226,182,90,0.15); color:#e2b65a; border:1px solid rgba(226,182,90,0.5); animation:hp-drain-pulse 1.5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .quest-status.done { background:rgba(60,208,122,0.12); color:#3cd07a; border:1px solid rgba(60,208,122,0.4); }
    .quest-status.locked { background:rgba(155,179,190,0.1); color:#9bb3be; border:1px solid rgba(155,179,190,0.3); }
    .quest-progress-wrap { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom:8px; }
    .quest-progress-bar { flex:1; height:4px; background:rgba(0,229,255,0.12); border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; position:relative; }
    .quest-progress-fill { height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, #00e5ff, #3cd07a); width:0%; transition:width 0.6s ease; box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,229,255,0.5); }
    .quest-progress-text { font-size:0.68rem; font-family:monospace; color:var(--color-gold); white-space:nowrap; }
    .quest-desc { font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--text-muted); line-height:1.4; }
    .quest-empty { color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.72rem; padding:14px; text-align:center; border:1px dashed rgba(0,229,255,0.2); border-radius:4px; }

    /* ====== Game Over — 系统崩坏版 ====== */
    @keyframes erased-glitch {
        0% { transform:translate(0,0); filter:hue-rotate(0deg) saturate(1) brightness(1); }
        10% { transform:translate(-8px,4px); filter:hue-rotate(120deg) saturate(2) brightness(1.8); }
        20% { transform:translate(6px,-6px); filter:hue-rotate(200deg) saturate(3) brightness(0.6) blur(1px); }
        30% { transform:translate(-4px,2px); filter:hue-rotate(300deg) saturate(1.5) brightness(1.4) blur(2px); }
        40% { transform:translate(10px,-3px); filter:hue-rotate(40deg) saturate(4) brightness(0.3); }
        50% { transform:translate(-2px,0); filter:hue-rotate(180deg) saturate(1) brightness(0.8); }
        55% { transform:translate(0,0); filter:none; }
        60% { filter: grayscale(0.25) brightness(0.6) saturate(0.5); }
        80% { filter: grayscale(0.45) brightness(0.5) saturate(0.35); }
        100% { filter: grayscale(0.55) brightness(0.42) saturate(0.25); border-color:rgba(100,100,100,0.1); }
    }
    .system-frame.frame-gameover {
        animation: erased-glitch 5s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) forwards;
        pointer-events: none;
    }
    .frame-gameover .sys-log-bar,
    .frame-gameover .panel-header,
    .frame-gameover .view-pane {
        animation: erased-inner 5s forwards;
    }
    @keyframes erased-inner {
        0% { opacity:1; }
        40% { opacity:0.1; filter:blur(2px); }
        55% { opacity:0; }
        100% { opacity:0; }
    }
    .frame-gameover::before,
    .frame-gameover::after {
        animation: erased-corners 5s forwards;
    }
    @keyframes erased-corners {
        0% { opacity:0.9; }
        55% { opacity:0; }
        100% { opacity:0; }
    }

    .gameover-bsod-overlay {
        position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:999;pointer-events:none;
        display:none; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-start;
        padding:30px 24px; font-family:monospace;
        background:rgba(0,0,0,0);
    }
    .frame-gameover .gameover-bsod-overlay {
        display:flex;
        pointer-events: auto;
        cursor: default;
        animation: bsod-bg 5.5s ease forwards;
    }
    @keyframes bsod-bg {
        0% { background:rgba(0,0,0,0); }
        60% { background:rgba(0,0,0,0); }
        100% { background:rgba(4,8,12,0.85); }
    }
    .bsod-title {
        font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:bold; color:#fff;
        margin-bottom:20px; letter-spacing:4px;
        animation:bsod-line-in 7s ease forwards; opacity:0;
        text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(200,210,220,0.25);
    }
    .bsod-body {
        font-size:0.7rem; color:rgba(220,230,240,0.9);
        line-height:1.8;
        animation:bsod-line-in 7.5s ease forwards; opacity:0;
    }
    .bsod-progress {
        margin-top:18px; font-size:0.65rem;
        color:rgba(200,215,225,0.8);
        white-space:pre-line; line-height:1.8;
        animation:bsod-line-in 8.5s ease forwards; opacity:0;
    }
    .bsod-cursor {
        margin-top:14px; color:#00e5ff; font-size:0.68rem;
        text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,229,255,0.4);
        animation:bsod-line-in 9.5s ease forwards,
                  bsod-blink 0.8s step-end infinite,
                  bsod-final-glow 12s ease forwards;
        opacity:0;
    }
    @keyframes bsod-final-glow {
        0%, 92% { color:#00e5ff; text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,229,255,0.4); filter:brightness(0.6); }
        100% { color:#ffffff; text-shadow:0 0 30px #00e5ff, 0 0 80px #00e5ff, 0 0 150px #00e5ff; filter:brightness(2.5); }
    }
    @keyframes bsod-line-in { 0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
    @keyframes bsod-blink {
        0% { opacity:1; color:#00e5ff; text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,229,255,0.5); }
        14% { opacity:1; color:#00e5ff; text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,229,255,0.5); }
        15% { opacity:1; color:#ff3366; text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,51,102,0.7); }
        18% { opacity:1; color:#ff3366; text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,51,102,0.7); }
        19% { opacity:1; color:#33ff66; text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(51,255,102,0.7); }
        22% { opacity:1; color:#33ff66; text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(51,255,102,0.7); }
        23% { opacity:1; color:#ffcc00; text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,204,0,0.7); }
        26% { opacity:1; color:#ffcc00; text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,204,0,0.7); }
        27% { opacity:1; color:#00e5ff; text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,229,255,0.5); }
        50% { opacity:0; }
        75% { opacity:1; color:#00e5ff; text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,229,255,0.5); }
        100% { opacity:0; }
    }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="panel-wrapper">
    <div class="system-frame">
        <input type="radio" id="tab-status" name="sys-grp" checked>
        <input type="radio" id="tab-mission" name="sys-grp">
        <input type="radio" id="tab-shop" name="sys-grp">
        <input type="radio" id="tab-guild" name="sys-grp">

        <!-- 全局系统警报日志滚动条 (System Logs) -->
        <div class="sys-log-bar" aria-hidden="true">
            <span class="sys-log-tag"><span class="rec-dot"></span>SYS LOG</span>
            <div class="sys-log-viewport">
                <div class="sys-log-track" id="sys-log-track">
                    <!-- 内容渲染时由脚本注入；track 平铺两份 content 以实现无缝循环 -->
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <header class="panel-header">
            <div class="title-area">
                <h1>深海系统面板</h1>
                <div class="status-pulse">Neural Link Active</div>
            </div>
            <div class="chip-switcher">
                <label for="tab-status" class="chip-btn label-status">控制台</label>
                <label for="tab-mission" class="chip-btn label-mission">任务流</label>
                <label for="tab-shop" class="chip-btn label-shop">暗网商城</label>
                <label for="tab-guild" class="chip-btn label-guild">公会</label>
            </div>
        </header>

        <!-- 控制台 -->
        <div class="view-pane pane-status">
            <div class="section-tag">▸ 生命体征</div>
            <div class="status-card">
                <div class="status-line">
                    <span class="line-label label-hp">HP</span>
                    <div class="line-track"><div class="line-fill" id="hp-fill" style="width:0; color:#00e5ff;"></div></div>
                    <span class="line-value" id="hp-text">{{1.hp}} / {{1.max_hp}}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="status-line">
                    <span class="line-label label-san">SAN</span>
                    <div class="line-track"><div class="line-fill" id="san-fill" style="width:0; color:#3cd07a;"></div></div>
                    <span class="line-value" id="san-text">{{1.san}} / {{1.max_san}}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="status-line" style="margin-top: 4px;">
                    <span class="line-label" style="color:var(--text-muted)">副本贡献值</span><div style="flex:1;"></div>
                    <span class="line-value gold-text" id="contrib-text">{{1.contrib}}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="collapse-warning" id="collapse-warning">⚠ 理智崩溃 · HP 正在以每秒1%流失</div>
            </div>

            <div class="section-tag">▸ 副本名称：<span class="dungeon-name-highlight" id="dungeon-name">{{1.dungeon}}</span></div>
            <div class="info-slate">
                <div class="slate-box diff-box" id="diff-box">
                    <span class="slate-lbl">副本评级</span>
                    <span class="slate-val diff-rank" id="diff-text">{{1.diff}}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="slate-box"><span class="slate-lbl">盲盒</span><span class="slate-val">{{1.box}}</span></div>
                <div class="slate-box span-full">
                    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between;">
                        <span class="slate-lbl">随身背包</span>
                        <span class="slate-val gold-text" style="font-size:0.7rem;">积分: {{1.bp_pts}} pt</span>
                    </div>
                    <span class="slate-val" style="color: var(--text-muted); margin-top:6px; cursor:pointer;" id="bp-items-text" title="点击查看背包">{{1.bp_items}}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 任务流 -->
        <div class="view-pane pane-mission">
            <div class="section-tag">▸ 深海主线</div>
            <div id="main-quest-slot">
                <!-- 由 renderQuest 动态填充结构化卡片 -->
            </div>
            <div class="section-tag">▸ 诅咒支线</div>
            <div id="sub-quest-slot"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- 商城 -->
        <div class="view-pane pane-shop">
            <div class="shop-balance" id="shop-balance">
                <span class="bal-lbl">当前积分余额</span>
                <span class="bal-val">{{1.bp_pts}} pt</span>
            </div>

            <!-- 分组切换条 -->
            <div class="shop-group-tabs" id="shop-group-tabs">
                <span class="grp-tab active" data-group="supply"><span class="grp-icon">🩹</span>应急补给</span>
                <span class="grp-tab" data-group="combat"><span class="grp-icon">⚔️</span>战斗武装</span>
                <span class="grp-tab" data-group="defense"><span class="grp-icon">🛡️</span>防护装备</span>
                <span class="grp-tab" data-group="tactical"><span class="grp-icon">⚡</span>战术道具</span>
                <span class="grp-tab" data-group="intel"><span class="grp-icon">🔍</span>情报调查</span>
                <span class="grp-tab" data-group="special"><span class="grp-icon">🔮</span>特殊珍品</span>
            </div>

            <!-- 内置商品列表 (由 JS 填充 + 合并 AI 动态商品) -->
            <div class="list-container" id="shop-list"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- 公会 -->
        <div class="view-pane pane-guild">
            <div class="section-tag">
                <span>▸ 契约公会</span>
                <button id="btn-show-guild-form" class="btn-create-trigger">建立公会</button>
            </div>

            <!-- 我的公会状态 (已加入时优先显示) -->
            <div class="cyber-form" id="guild-my-view" style="display:none;">
                <div class="detail-highlight" id="myguild-name">--</div>
                <div class="guild-tag-line">
                    <span>▸ 我的公会状态</span>
                    <span class="guild-badge" style="background:rgba(0,229,255,0.15);color:#00e5ff;">已加入</span>
                </div>
                <div class="info-slate" style="margin-bottom:0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
                    <div class="slate-box"><span class="slate-lbl">个人权限/职位</span><span class="slate-val" id="myguild-position" style="color:var(--color-gold);">--</span></div>
                    <div class="slate-box"><span class="slate-lbl">结社贡献值</span><span class="slate-val gold-text" id="myguild-contrib">0</span></div>
                    <div class="slate-box"><span class="slate-lbl">公会规模</span><span class="slate-val" id="myguild-type">--</span></div>
                    <div class="slate-box"><span class="slate-lbl">已知成员</span><span class="slate-val" id="myguild-members">--</span></div>
                    <div class="slate-box span-full"><span class="slate-lbl">公会简介</span><span class="slate-val" id="myguild-desc" style="line-height:1.4;">--</span></div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-actions">
                    <button class="action-btn btn-cancel" id="btn-browse-guild">浏览其他公会</button>
                    <button class="action-btn btn-submit btn-exit" id="btn-exit-guild">退出公会</button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 现存公会列表 (默认显示) -->
            <!-- 增加了自定义数据属性以便点击时读取详情 -->
            <div class="list-container" id="guild-list-view">
                <!-- 内置常驻公会：新人互助联盟 -->
                <div class="item-card guild-card guild-featured"
                     data-gname="深渊守望·新人互助联盟"
                     data-gdesc="系统默认注册公会。所有初入无限流的新人自动获得入会资格。联盟宗旨：守望相助，绝不抛弃任何一个还在呼吸的人。联盟提供基础物资共享、副本情报互助和紧急救援频道。没有门槛，没有会费，只有活下去的约定。"
                     data-gtype="大型公会"
                     data-gmembers="全体新人(自动) / 守望者·零号(发起人) / 系统分配联络员">
                    <div class="item-info">
                        <span class="item-name">深渊守望·新人互助联盟<span class="guild-badge">官方</span></span>
                        <span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.7rem; margin-top:4px; max-height: 14px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">系统默认注册 · 守望相助，绝不抛弃</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="color:var(--color-gold); font-size:0.75rem; font-family:monospace; margin-left:10px; white-space:nowrap;">大型公会</div>
                </div>
                <!-- AI 动态公会列表 -->
                {{#each:1.guild}}
                <div class="item-card guild-card" data-gname="{{name}}" data-gdesc="{{desc}}" data-gtype="{{type}}" data-gmembers="{{members}}">
                    <div class="item-info">
                        <span class="item-name">{{name}}</span>
                        <span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.7rem; margin-top:4px; max-height: 14px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">{{desc}}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="color:var(--color-gold); font-size:0.75rem; font-family:monospace; margin-left:10px; white-space:nowrap;">{{type}}</div>
                </div>
                {{/each}}
            </div>

            <!-- 公会档案详情面板 (默认隐藏) -->
            <div class="cyber-form" id="guild-detail-view" style="display: none;">
                <div class="detail-highlight" id="detail-name">--</div>

                <div class="info-slate" style="margin-bottom:0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
                    <div class="slate-box"><span class="slate-lbl">公会规模</span><span class="slate-val" id="detail-type" style="color:var(--color-gold);">--</span></div>
                    <div class="slate-box"><span class="slate-lbl">已知成员</span><span class="slate-val" id="detail-members">--</span></div>
                    <div class="slate-box span-full"><span class="slate-lbl">公会简介</span><span class="slate-val" id="detail-desc" style="line-height: 1.4;">--</span></div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-actions">
                    <button class="action-btn btn-cancel" id="btn-back-detail">返回列表</button>
                    <button class="action-btn btn-submit" id="btn-join-guild">申请加入</button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 建立公会表单 (默认隐藏) -->
            <div class="cyber-form" id="guild-create-form">
                <input type="text" id="g-name" class="cyber-input" placeholder="输入公会名称...">
                <input type="text" id="g-desc" class="cyber-input" placeholder="公会简介（选填）...">
                <input type="text" id="g-members" class="cyber-input" placeholder="初始成员（如：主角, 零号）...">

                <select id="g-size" class="cyber-input">
                    <option value="" disabled selected>选择公会规模</option>
                    <option value="小型公会" data-cost="500">小型公会 (基础投资: 500 pt)</option>
                    <option value="中型公会" data-cost="2000">中型公会 (基础投资: 2000 pt)</option>
                    <option value="大型公会" data-cost="5000">大型公会 (基础投资: 5000 pt)</option>
                </select>

                <!-- 启动资金自动计算显示 -->
                <input type="text" id="g-capital" class="cyber-input" readonly placeholder="请先选择公会规模以计算启动资金...">

                <div style="font-size:0.62rem;color:var(--text-muted);line-height:1.4;margin-top:-4px;">
                  提交后公会将加入下方指令缓冲区，可与商城物资合并一次性结算发送，互不覆盖。
                </div>

                <div class="form-actions">
                    <button class="action-btn btn-cancel" id="btn-cancel-guild">取消终止</button>
                    <button class="action-btn btn-submit" id="btn-submit-guild">加入指令清单</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 全局操作台浮动条 (两排：上排物品，下排操作) -->
        <div class="cart-bar" id="cart-bar">
            <div class="cart-row-top">
                <div class="cart-items" id="cart-items"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="cart-row-bottom">
                <span class="cart-badge">⚙️ <span id="cart-count">0</span></span>
                <span class="cart-total">合计: <span id="cart-total-val">0</span> pt</span>
                <button class="btn-cart-clear" id="btn-cart-clear">清空</button>
                <button class="btn-cart-submit" id="btn-cart-submit">结算</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 盲盒开启弹窗 -->
        <div class="box-modal-overlay" id="box-modal-overlay">
            <div class="box-modal" id="box-modal">
                <div class="box-modal-title">📦 开启盲盒</div>
                <div class="box-qty-wrap">
                    <button class="box-qty-btn" id="box-qty-minus">−</button>
                    <input type="text" class="box-qty-input" id="box-qty-input" value="1">
                    <button class="box-qty-btn" id="box-qty-plus">+</button>
                </div>
                <div class="box-modal-actions">
                    <button class="action-btn btn-cancel" id="btn-box-cancel" style="flex:1;">取消</button>
                    <button class="action-btn btn-submit" id="btn-box-open" style="flex:1;">开启</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 随身背包弹窗 -->
        <div class="bp-modal-overlay" id="bp-modal-overlay">
            <div class="bp-modal" id="bp-modal">
                <div class="bp-modal-title">🎒 随身背包</div>
                <div class="bp-grid" id="bp-grid"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 物品使用弹窗 -->
        <div class="bp-modal-overlay" id="bp-use-overlay">
            <div class="bp-modal bp-use-modal" id="bp-use-modal">
                <div class="bp-modal-title" id="bp-use-title">是否使用</div>
                <div class="bp-use-name" id="bp-use-name">--</div>
                <div class="bp-use-desc" id="bp-use-desc">--</div>
                <div class="bp-use-price" id="bp-use-price" style="display:none;"></div>
                <div class="box-qty-wrap">
                    <button class="box-qty-btn" id="bp-use-minus">−</button>
                    <input type="text" class="box-qty-input" id="bp-use-input" value="1">
                    <button class="box-qty-btn" id="bp-use-plus">+</button>
                </div>
                <div class="box-modal-actions" id="bp-use-actions">
                    <button class="action-btn btn-cancel" id="btn-bp-cancel" style="flex:1;">取消</button>
                    <button class="action-btn btn-submit" id="btn-bp-use" style="flex:1;display:none;">使用</button>
                    <button class="action-btn btn-submit" id="btn-bp-sell" style="flex:1;display:none;background:#e2b65a;color:#000;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(226,182,90,0.4);">售卖</button>
                    <button class="action-btn btn-submit" id="btn-bp-gift" style="flex:1;display:none;background:rgba(0,229,255,0.15);color:#00e5ff;border:1px solid #00e5ff;">赠予</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

            </div>
            <div class="bsod-progress">
                ► 正在回收人格碎片...  ██████░░░░  57%<br>
                ► 正在打包意识数据...  ████████░░  82%<br>

            <div class="bsod-cursor">> 再见，玩家。已被登记为系统异常数据。_</div>
        </div>

        <!-- 隐藏数据节点：ST 渲染时用 {{1.xxx}} 填充各标量字段，JS 逐项读取 -->
        <!-- 注意：{{1.myGuild}} 对象整体无法在 text 上下文中正确序列化，必须拆分到标量 -->
        <span style="display:none" id="hid-joined">{{1.myGuild.joined}}</span>
        <span style="display:none" id="hid-myguild-name">{{1.myGuild.name}}</span>

        <span style="display:none" id="hid-quest-sub">{{1.quest.sub_quest}}</span>

            <span class="dyn-shop-item" data-name="{{name}}" data-category="{{category}}" data-group="{{group}}" data-rarity="{{rarity}}" data-price="{{price}}" data-desc="{{desc}}" data-once="{{once}}"></span>

            {{/each}}
        </div>

    </div>
</div>

<script>
(function initDynamicPanel() {
    // === 全局系统警报日志滚动条 (System Logs) ===
    // 纯视觉装饰：循环滚动一组赛博朋克风提示。内容复制两份以实现无缝循环。
    const LOG_MESSAGES = [
        "欢迎来到无限流世界，你做好准备了吗？",
        "NEURAL LINK 已建立 · 神经链路稳定",
        "警告：SAN 值过低会触发认知污染",
        "扫描周边信号源中......",
        "深海主控系统在线 · 持续监测生命体征",
        "提醒：低 HP 时请尽快使用补给品",
        "副本数据流实时同步",
        "契约结社协议待激活",
        ">> 系统日志流末尾 <<"
    ];
    const logTrack = document.getElementById('sys-log-track');
    if (logTrack) {
        const sep = '  ◆  ';
        const contentHtml = LOG_MESSAGES.join(sep);
        // 平铺两份，translateX(-50%) 时第二份恰好接上第一份起点，无缝
        logTrack.innerHTML =
            '<span class="sys-log-content">' + contentHtml + '</span>' +
            '<span class="sys-log-content" aria-hidden="true">' + contentHtml + '</span>';
    }

    // === 任务流结构化渲染 + 贡献值/副本名称逻辑 ===
    // AI 的 main_quest / sub_quest 既可能是旧式纯文本，也可能是新式 JSON 字符串（含 status/progress）
    const STATUS_LABEL = {
        active: '进行中', claimable: '可领取', done: '已完成', locked: '未开启'
    };

    function renderQuest(slotEl, rawValue, accent) {
        if (!slotEl) return;

        // 未渲染（仍是模板占位符）时留空，等数据到位
        if (typeof rawValue !== 'string' || rawValue.includes('{{') || !rawValue.trim()) {
            slotEl.innerHTML = '<div class="quest-empty">暂无任务</div>';
            return;
        }

        let q = null;
        try { q = JSON.parse(rawValue); } catch(_) { q = null; }

        // 旧式纯文本：直接展示，不结构化
        if (!q || typeof q !== 'object') {
            slotEl.innerHTML = '<div class="quest-card" style="border-left:3px solid ' + accent + ';">' +
                '<span class="quest-desc" style="color:#d1dfdf;">' + rawValue + '</span></div>';
            return;
        }

        // 新式结构化：{title, status, progress:[cur,max], desc}
        const status = q.status || 'active';
        const label = STATUS_LABEL[status] || status;
        const title = q.title || '未命名任务';
        const desc = q.desc || '';

        let progressHtml = '';
        if (q.progress && Array.isArray(q.progress) && q.progress.length >= 2) {
            const cur = parseFloat(q.progress[0]), mx = parseFloat(q.progress[1]);
            if (!isNaN(cur) && !isNaN(mx) && mx > 0) {
                const pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (cur / mx) * 100));
                progressHtml = '<div class="quest-progress-wrap">' +
                    '<div class="quest-progress-bar"><div class="quest-progress-fill" style="width:' + pct + '%;"></div></div>' +
                    '<span class="quest-progress-text">' + cur + ' / ' + mx + '</span>' +
                '</div>';
            }
        }

        slotEl.innerHTML = '<div class="quest-card" style="border-left:3px solid ' + accent + ';">' +
            '<div class="quest-head">' +
                '<span class="quest-title">' + title + '</span>' +
                '<span class="quest-status ' + status + '">' + label + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            progressHtml +
            (desc ? '<div class="quest-desc">' + desc + '</div>' : '') +
        '</div>';
    }

    // 副本名称：未进副本时显示「无」
    function applyDungeonName() {
        const el = document.getElementById('dungeon-name');
        if (!el) return;
        const txt = el.innerText.trim();
        if (!txt || txt.includes('{{') || txt === '无' || txt === 'none') {
            el.innerText = '无';
            el.style.opacity = '0.4';
            el.style.fontStyle = 'italic';
        } else {
            el.style.opacity = '';
            el.style.fontStyle = '';
        }
    }

    // 副本贡献值：未进副本时显示「无」
    function applyContrib() {
        const el = document.getElementById('contrib-text');
        if (!el) return;
        let txt = el.innerText.trim();
        txt = txt.replace(/ pt$/, '');
        if (!txt || txt.includes('{{') || txt === '无' || txt === '0' || txt === 'none') {
            el.innerText = '无';
            el.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
            el.style.fontStyle = 'italic';
        } else {
            el.style.color = '';
            el.style.fontStyle = '';
            el.innerText = txt + ' pt';
        }
    }

    // 从隐藏数据节点读取 AI 任务数据（由 ST 烘焙进来）
    // 从隐藏 span 读取标量值（ST 渲染后取值，避免对象整体序列化问题）
    function escAttr(s) {
        return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
    }

    function readHidden(id, fallback) {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) return fallback;
        const txt = el.textContent.trim();
        return txt || fallback;
    }

    // 从隐藏 shop 容器读取 AI 动态商品
    function getDynamicShop() {
        var items = [];
        var container = document.getElementById('hid-dynamic-shop');
        if (!container) return items;
        var spans = container.querySelectorAll('.dyn-shop-item');
        spans.forEach(function(el) {
            var onceAttr = el.getAttribute('data-once');
            var item = {
                name: el.getAttribute('data-name') || '',
                category: el.getAttribute('data-category') || '',
                group: el.getAttribute('data-group') || 'supply',
                rarity: el.getAttribute('data-rarity') || 'common',
                price: parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-price')) || 0,
                desc: el.getAttribute('data-desc') || ''
            };
            if (onceAttr && (onceAttr === 'true' || onceAttr === '1')) item.once = true;
            items.push(item);
        });
        return items;
    }

    // 读取 quest 数据（从隐藏 span）
    function getQuestData() {
        const mainRaw = readHidden('hid-quest-main', '');
        const subRaw = readHidden('hid-quest-sub', '');
        return { main_quest: mainRaw, sub_quest: subRaw };
    }

    function renderQuests() {
        const q = getQuestData();
        renderQuest(document.getElementById('main-quest-slot'), q.main_quest, '#00e5ff');
        renderQuest(document.getElementById('sub-quest-slot'), q.sub_quest, 'var(--text-muted)');
    }

    // === 基础条与颜色更新 + 危险态视觉反馈 ===
    const hpText = document.getElementById('hp-text');
    const hpFill = document.getElementById('hp-fill');
    const sanText = document.getElementById('san-text');
    const sanFill = document.getElementById('san-fill');
    const diffText = document.getElementById('diff-text');
    const collapseWarning = document.getElementById('collapse-warning');
    const frame = document.querySelector('.system-frame');

    let hpDrainTimer = null; // SAN=0 时 HP 倒计时
    let sanDrainTimer = null; // HP=0 时 SAN 倒计时

    function updateBar(textEl, fillEl, defaultColor) {
        if (!textEl || !fillEl) return;
        const text = textEl.innerText.trim();
        const parts = text.split('/');
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            const current = parseFloat(parts[0]);
            const max = parseFloat(parts[1]);
            if (!isNaN(current) && !isNaN(max) && max > 0) {
                const ratio = current / max;
                let color = defaultColor;
                if (ratio < 0.3) color = '#ff3333';
                else if (ratio < 0.5) color = '#e2b65a';
                fillEl.style.color = color;
                fillEl.style.width = (ratio * 100) + '%';
                textEl.style.color = color;
            }
        }
    }

    // 读取当前 HP / SAN 的数值（从已渲染的文本中解析）
    function getHpValues() {
        const text = hpText ? hpText.innerText.trim() : '';
        const parts = text.split('/');
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            const cur = parseFloat(parts[0]), mx = parseFloat(parts[1]);
            if (!isNaN(cur) && !isNaN(mx) && mx > 0) return { current: cur, max: mx, ratio: cur / mx };
        }
        // 仍有模板占位符时 fallback
        return { current: 100, max: 100, ratio: 1 };
    }
    function getSanValues() {
        const text = sanText ? sanText.innerText.trim() : '';
        const parts = text.split('/');
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            const cur = parseFloat(parts[0]), mx = parseFloat(parts[1]);
            if (!isNaN(cur) && !isNaN(mx) && mx > 0) return { current: cur, max: mx, ratio: cur / mx };
        }
        return { current: 100, max: 100, ratio: 1 };
    }

    // 危险态 class 切换 — 每次数值更新后调用
    function updateCriticalEffects() {
        const san = getSanValues();
        const hp = getHpValues();

        // HP < 15%（但不为0）或 SAN < 15%（但不为0）→ glitch
        const hpLowGlitch = hp.current > 0 && hp.ratio < 0.15;
        const sanLowGlitch = san.current > 0 && san.ratio < 0.15;
        frame.classList.toggle('frame-glitch', hpLowGlitch || sanLowGlitch);

        // HP < 30%（但不为0）或 SAN < 30%（但不为0）→ 红雾光晕
        const hpCritical = hp.current > 0 && hp.ratio < 0.3;
        const sanCritical = san.current > 0 && san.ratio < 0.3;
        const anyCritical = hpCritical || sanCritical;
        frame.classList.toggle('frame-critical', anyCritical);
        if (anyCritical) {
            // 光晕强度：谁更严重就用谁的比率驱动
            const ratioForGlow = hpCritical ? hp.ratio : san.ratio;
            const glowIntensity = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (0.3 - ratioForGlow) / 0.3));
            frame.style.setProperty('--hp-glow', glowIntensity);
        }

        // === 双轨崩坏：任一方归零 → 另一方每秒 -1，直至双双归零 → Game Over ===

        // 停用所有定时器的公共函数
        function stopAllDrains() {
            if (hpDrainTimer) { clearInterval(hpDrainTimer); hpDrainTimer = null; }
            if (sanDrainTimer) { clearInterval(sanDrainTimer); sanDrainTimer = null; }
            hpText.classList.remove('draining');
            sanText.classList.remove('draining');
            if (collapseWarning) collapseWarning.classList.remove('visible');
        }

        // SAN=0 但 HP>0 → HP 每秒 -1
        if (san.current === 0 && san.max > 0 && hp.current > 0) {
            if (!hpDrainTimer) {
                hpText.classList.add('draining');
                if (collapseWarning) {
                    collapseWarning.innerText = '⚠ 理智崩溃 · HP 正在以每秒1点流失';
                    collapseWarning.classList.add('visible');
                }
                let displayHp = hp.current;
                hpDrainTimer = setInterval(function() {
                    displayHp = Math.max(0, displayHp - 1);
                    var rounded = Math.round(displayHp);
                    hpText.innerText = rounded + ' / ' + hp.max;
                    hpFill.style.width = ((displayHp / hp.max) * 100) + '%';
                    hpFill.style.color = '#ff3333';
                    hpText.style.color = '#ff3333';
                    if (displayHp <= 0) { clearInterval(hpDrainTimer); hpDrainTimer = null; }
                }, 1000);
            }
        }
        // HP=0 但 SAN>0 → SAN 每秒 -1
        else if (hp.current === 0 && hp.max > 0 && san.current > 0) {
            if (!sanDrainTimer) {
                sanText.classList.add('draining');
                if (collapseWarning) {
                    collapseWarning.innerText = '⚠ 躯体崩溃 · SAN 正在以每秒1点流失';
                    collapseWarning.classList.add('visible');
                }
                let displaySan = san.current;
                sanDrainTimer = setInterval(function() {
                    displaySan = Math.max(0, displaySan - 1);
                    var rounded = Math.round(displaySan);
                    sanText.innerText = rounded + ' / ' + san.max;
                    sanFill.style.width = ((displaySan / san.max) * 100) + '%';
                    sanFill.style.color = '#ff3333';
                    sanText.style.color = '#ff3333';
                    if (displaySan <= 0) { clearInterval(sanDrainTimer); sanDrainTimer = null; }
                }, 1000);
            }
        }
        // 两者都正常 → 停止所有倒计时
        else if (san.current > 0 && hp.current > 0) {
            if (hpDrainTimer || sanDrainTimer) { stopAllDrains(); }
        }
        // 两者都为0 → 停止所有倒计时（交给 Game Over 处理）
        else if (san.current === 0 && hp.current === 0) {
            if (hpDrainTimer || sanDrainTimer) { stopAllDrains(); }
        }
    }

    function updateDifficulty(diffEl) {
        if (!diffEl) return;
        const text = diffEl.innerText.toUpperCase().trim();
        if (text.includes('{{')) return;
        let color = '#9bb3be', shadow = 'none', rgb = '155,179,190';
        if (text.includes('SSS级'))      { color = '#ff1a1a'; shadow = '0 0 18px rgba(255,26,26,1), 0 0 36px rgba(180,0,0,0.8)'; rgb = '255,26,26'; }
        else if (text.includes('SS级')) { color = '#ff3333'; shadow = '0 0 14px rgba(255,51,51,0.9), 0 0 28px rgba(200,0,0,0.6)';  rgb = '255,51,51'; }
        else if (text.includes('S级'))  { color = '#ff5555'; shadow = '0 0 10px rgba(255,85,85,0.7), 0 0 20px rgba(220,30,30,0.5)'; rgb = '255,85,85'; }
        else if (text.includes('A级'))  { color = '#ff7700'; shadow = '0 0 8px rgba(255,119,0,0.5)'; rgb = '255,119,0'; }
        else if (text.includes('B级'))  { color = '#e2b65a'; shadow = '0 0 6px rgba(226,182,90,0.4)'; rgb = '226,182,90'; }
        else if (text.includes('C级'))  { color = '#00e5ff'; shadow = '0 0 8px rgba(0,229,255,0.5)'; rgb = '0,229,255'; }
        else if (text.includes('D级'))  { color = '#3cd07a'; shadow = '0 0 6px rgba(60,208,122,0.3)'; rgb = '60,208,122'; }
        else if (text.includes('E级'))  { color = '#9bb3be'; shadow = '0 0 4px rgba(155,179,190,0.2)'; rgb = '155,179,190'; }
        diffEl.style.color = color; diffEl.style.textShadow = shadow;
        // 驱动整个评级格子的光晕颜色
        const diffBox = document.getElementById('diff-box');
        if (diffBox) diffBox.style.setProperty('--diff-rgb', rgb);
    }

    let attempts = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
        attempts++;
        // 若仍是未渲染的模板占位符则跳过本轮，等数据到位
        if (hpText.innerText.includes('{{') || sanText.innerText.includes('{{')) {
            if (attempts >= 50) clearInterval(timer);
            return;
        }
        updateBar(hpText, hpFill, '#00e5ff');
        updateBar(sanText, sanFill, '#3cd07a');
        updateDifficulty(diffText);
        updateCriticalEffects();
        applyDungeonName();
        applyContrib();
        renderQuests();
        if (attempts >= 50) clearInterval(timer);
    }, 100);

    // === Game Over 检测：hp === 0 时触发系统崩坏动画 ===
    // 双击 BSOD 可关闭，关闭后不会再次触发，直到 hp 恢复 >0 重置
    let gameOverDismissed = false;

    function dismissGameOver() {
        const overlay = document.querySelector('.gameover-bsod-overlay');
        frame.classList.remove('frame-gameover');
        gameOverDismissed = true;
    }

    function checkGameOver() {
        const hp = getHpValues();
        const san = getSanValues();
        if (hp.current <= 0 && san.current <= 0 && hp.max > 0 && san.max > 0) {
            if (!frame.classList.contains('frame-gameover') && !gameOverDismissed) {
                frame.classList.add('frame-gameover');
            }
        } else {
            if (frame.classList.contains('frame-gameover') || gameOverDismissed) {
                frame.classList.remove('frame-gameover');
                gameOverDismissed = false; // 满血复活后重置，下次死亡可再次触发
            }
        }
    }
    const goTimer = setInterval(() => {
        checkGameOver();
    }, 200);

    // 双击 BSOD 覆盖层关闭 Game Over
    document.querySelector('.gameover-bsod-overlay').addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) {
        if (frame.classList.contains('frame-gameover')) {
            dismissGameOver();
        }
    });

    // 通用发信函数
    function sendSysCommand(payload) {
        try {
            window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'chat-input-fill', text: payload }, '*');
            window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'data-fill', value: payload }, '*');
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Data dispatch failed', e);
        }
    }

    // === 暗网商城：积分联动 + 购买按钮 + 分组 ===
    // 内置商品（AI 不输出也会存在的常驻货架）。category 用于分组，rarity 对应圆点颜色
    const BUILTIN_SHOP = [
        // 应急补给 — 新手大礼包置顶且限购
        { name: "新手大礼包", category: "应急补给", group: "supply", rarity: "common", price: 500, once: true,
          desc: "3医疗包 + 5压缩饼干 + 1匕首 + 返还450积分（限购一次）" },
        { name: "医疗包", category: "消耗品", group: "supply", rarity: "common", price: 80,

            tab.classList.toggle('empty', !counts[g]);

            if (g === activeGroup && !counts[g]) {

    const cart = []; // {name, price, desc, once, qty}

    function renderCart() {
        const bar = document.getElementById('cart-bar');
        const items = document.getElementById('cart-items');
        const countEl = document.getElementById('cart-count');
        const totalEl = document.getElementById('cart-total-val');
        if (!bar) return;

        const totalQty = cart.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.qty || 1), 0);
        bar.classList.toggle('visible', cart.length > 0);
        countEl.textContent = totalQty;
        totalEl.textContent = cart.reduce((s, c) => s + c.price * (c.qty || 1), 0);

        items.innerHTML = cart.map((c, i) => {
            const tip = c.desc ? ' title="' + c.desc.replace(/"/g, '"') + '"' : '';
            const label = (c.qty > 1) ? c.name + ' ×' + c.qty : c.name;
            return '<span class="cart-chip"' + tip + '>' + label + ' <span class="chip-x" data-idx="' + i + '">×</span></span>';

        if (!btn || btn.disabled) return;
        const name = btn.getAttribute('data-name');
        const price = parseFloat(btn.getAttribute('data-price'));
        const card = btn.closest('.shop-card');
        const once = card && card.hasAttribute('data-once');

        // 限购品已在购物车中 → 不再加入（不可重复购买）
        if (once && cart.some(c => c.name === name)) return;

        // 非限购品且已在购物车 → 累加数量
        if (!once) {
            const existing = cart.find(c => c.name === name);
            if (existing) {
                existing.qty = (existing.qty || 1) + 1;
                renderCart();
                return;
            }
        }

        const info = findItemInfo(name);
        cart.push({ name, price, once: !!once, desc: info ? info.desc : '', qty: 1 });

        // 限购品立即视觉灰掉
        if (once) {
            btn.disabled = true;
            card.classList.add('sold-out');
        }

        renderCart();
    });

        const item = cart[idx];

        if ((item.qty || 1) > 1) {
            item.qty--;
        } else {
            cart.splice(idx, 1);
            if (item.once) {
                const card = document.querySelector('.shop-card[data-once]');
                if (card) {
                    card.classList.remove('sold-out');

  category  → 中文分类，如"消耗品""武器""防具""道具""情报""特殊"

每轮输出前先读上文，判定处于哪个阶段：

① 平台/日常    → 不在副本。contrib/dungeon/diff/box/quest 全部清空。hp/san=100/100
